description: Na₃Nd₅Cl₁₈ crystallizes in the hexagonal P̅6 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine Cl atoms. There are six shorter (2.96 Å) and three longer (3.10 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to six Cl atoms. There are three shorter (2.73 Å) and three longer (3.36 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Nd sites. In the first Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine Cl atoms. There are a spread of Nd-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.00 Å. In the second Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine Cl atoms. There are six shorter (2.89 Å) and three longer (2.97 Å) Nd-Cl bond lengths. In the third Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine Cl atoms. There are a spread of Nd-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.88-2.95 Å. There are four inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Nd atoms. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to two Na and two Nd atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₂Nd₂ tetrahedra. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Nd atoms. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nd atoms.
